paper.title: Toward Training Superintelligent Software Agents through Self-Play SWE-RL
paper.central_claim: 仅给原始仓库和依赖，通过共享策略的 bug 注入—修复自博弈 RL 获得持续软件能力提升，在 SWE-bench Verified/Pro 超过 human-data RL，并指向开放式超智能。

provenance.notes: 按用户指定 sonnet→gpt-6.1-sol；无独立可验证实际模型回执或 session/receipt 标识，故 null。仅读固定材料及规则，未读既有三篇输出及其他席/批次/attempt。

sections_read: Appendices A–E（含全部长提示模板）

evidence.quote: Both roles share parameters and are trained jointly with RL.
evidence.support_explanation: Proposer/solver learning updates shared model parameters, not a retained harness.

evidence.quote: We use the same LLM for bug generation and repair, where the shared policy weights are updated continuously during RL.
evidence.support_explanation: The evaluated self-improvement object is policy weights.

evidence.quote: Our implementation employs the same tool-based scaffold as CWM with minor prompt adjustments, incorporating Bash and a search-replace editor. All environment images used in our experiments are identical to those in CWM.
evidence.support_explanation: Scaffold is inherited and not feedback-evolved.

evidence.quote:
These failed attempts are converted into
higher-order bugs
based on the new bug states derived by the agent.
evidence.support_explanation: Failed patches supply training tasks, not reusable action-space tools or a learning mechanism.

evidence.quote: the bug-injection agent learns to create higher-quality bugs that are more consistent and tailored for the solver through RL.
evidence.support_explanation: Self-generated execution-verified curriculum trains the proposer.

evidence.quote: solver feedback provides only a slight and largely negligible advantage over the consistency baseline.
evidence.support_explanation: Frontier reward is not demonstrated essential.

evidence.quote: Providing the complete oracle (i.e. the tests) in the task specification prompt may enable agents to develop reward-hacking behaviors
and train the models (including baseline RL, SSR, and all ablation runs) for 150 global steps, roughly 2.5B tokens,
evidence.support_explanation: Matched training steps/tokens are reported, not a harness-retention comparison.

signatures.object: 共享 CWM-sft 策略权重
signatures.information: 注入者见原始仓库/git 历史；solver 见被破坏仓库及反转测试补丁，git 历史重置
signatures.operation: 生成 bug artifact→执行一致性检验→8 次 solver 尝试估难度→双方 RL
signatures.output: 更新的共享参数与供训练的 bug artifacts
signatures.conditions: 已有仓库依赖；可运行测试；原始/损坏/弱化测试的对比
signatures.feedback: 一致性通过与 solver solve rate / 全测试 pass
signatures.selection_rule: 无效 bug 拒绝；极端 solve rate 惩罚；训练更新权重
signatures.persistence: 跨训练步保存权重；非权重 bug 数据用于 RL，不是下游部署的可编辑 harness
signatures.later_use: 更新策略继续注入/修复并评测 benchmark
signatures.failure_boundary: 可被难度目标博弈、测试全可见、训练不稳定；不构成本领域非权重留存
